methodology.sizes: esbuild minify, gzip level 9, Brotli quality 11; raw generated sizes also retained
methodology.order: baseline/candidate alternate each round; profiles rotate; each sample is a fresh Node process
methodology.initialization: one unminified generated module import with pre-import GC; heap delta includes transient allocations, not retained heap
methodology.browser: candidate all versus baseline off; 200 React updates forcing computed style; includes React, DOM and style calculation, not isolated CSS engine time or a gate-only comparison
